subScenes.name: 察觉情绪
subScenes.description: 朋友情绪低落，你主动关心并开启对话。

qaPairs.triggerText: You seem a bit down today. Everything okay?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你今天看起来有点低落，还好吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友察觉你情绪低落，主动关心

followUps.text: Yeah, I just had a rough day at work. Thanks for asking.
followUps.text_cn: 是啊，今天工作不太顺，谢谢你关心。

followUps.text: I’m actually fine, just tired. Don’t worry about me!
followUps.text_cn: 我其实没事，只是有点累，别担心我！

followUps.text: To be honest, I’m feeling kind of overwhelmed. Can we grab coffee later and talk?
followUps.text_cn: 说实话，我有点被压垮了，待会儿能一起喝杯咖啡聊聊吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友察觉你情绪变化时的自然回应，体现不同开放程度：从轻描淡写到主动求助。

qaPairs.triggerText: You’ve been quiet all evening. Something on your mind?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你今晚一直很安静，有什么心事吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友注意到你沉默寡言，试探性关心

followUps.text: I’m just thinking about that big presentation tomorrow. Nervous, honestly.
followUps.text_cn: 我只是在想明天的大演讲，说实话有点紧张。

followUps.text: Not really, just zoning out. I’m good, promise!
followUps.text_cn: 没什么，只是在放空。我真没事，保证！

followUps.text: I miss my grandma. It’s her anniversary today… I didn’t want to bring it up.
followUps.text_cn: 我想念我奶奶了，今天是她的忌日……我不想提这事。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应朋友对沉默的观察，体现从理性焦虑到情感伤痛的不同层次。

qaPairs.triggerText: You didn’t laugh at all during the movie. You okay?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你看电影时一点都没笑，你还好吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友注意到你在轻松场合情绪异常，表达关心

followUps.text: The movie was just not my vibe—I’m not in the mood for comedies today.
followUps.text_cn: 这部电影不合我口味，今天实在没心情看喜剧。

followUps.text: I’m just not feeling like socializing right now. I need some quiet time.
followUps.text_cn: 我现在不想社交，想一个人静静。

followUps.text: I’m sorry—I’ve been crying quietly. I didn’t want to ruin the night.
followUps.text_cn: 对不起，我刚才偷偷哭了，不想扫了大家的兴。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应朋友对情绪异常的观察，体现从偏好差异到情感压抑的多种真实心理状态。

subScenes.name: 表达同情
subScenes.description: 用恰当语言回应朋友的挫折，展现理解与共情。

qaPairs.triggerText: I'm so sorry to hear about your dad.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 听到你爸爸的事，我真的很难过。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友表达对亲人离世的同情

followUps.text: Thanks, it's been really hard these past few weeks.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢，过去几周真的很难熬。

followUps.text: I appreciate that. I'm trying to stay strong for my mom.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你。我正在努力为妈妈坚强起来。

followUps.text: I'm not ready to talk about it yet, but I'm glad you're here.
followUps.text_cn: 我还没准备好谈这件事，但很高兴你在我身边。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于回应朋友对亲人离世的安慰，根据情绪状态选择不同回应方式，体现真实情感层次。

qaPairs.triggerText: That sounds so tough — how are you holding up?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 听起来太难了——你现在还好吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友关心你正在经历的困难（如失业、分手）

followUps.text: Honestly? I'm just taking it one day at a time.
followUps.text_cn: 说实话？我只能一天一天撑着。

followUps.text: Better than yesterday — small wins, you know?
followUps.text_cn: 比昨天好一点了——你知道的，小进步也算进步。

followUps.text: I'm okay, but I just need some quiet time right now.
followUps.text_cn: 我还行，但现在只是需要一点安静的时间。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应朋友对个人困境的关心，避免过度消极或虚假乐观，体现真实心理状态。

qaPairs.triggerText: I can't imagine how you're feeling right now.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我真无法想象你现在是什么感受。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友试图共情你经历的重大挫折（如事故、疾病）

followUps.text: That means a lot — just knowing you get it helps.
followUps.text_cn: 这对我来说意义重大——知道你理解，我就觉得好些了。

followUps.text: I'm not even sure how I feel myself — but thanks for saying that.
followUps.text_cn: 我自己都不太清楚是什么感觉——但谢谢你这么说。

followUps.text: Actually, I'm more worried about my sister — she's taking it harder.
followUps.text_cn: 其实我更担心我妹妹——她承受得更重。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应朋友表达无力感式共情时，可选择情感接纳、情绪诚实或转向他人关怀三种自然反应，避免机械式感谢。

subScenes.name: 安抚情绪
subScenes.description: 帮助朋友平复激动情绪，减轻心理压力。

qaPairs.triggerText: I know things are tough right now.
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友安慰你情绪低落时，你如何回应？

followUps.text: Thanks, I just needed to hear that.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你，我就是需要有人这么说。

followUps.text: I’m okay, but I just needed to vent a little.
followUps.text_cn: 我还好，只是想发泄一下。

followUps.text: I don’t know if I’ll get over this anytime soon.
followUps.text_cn: 我不知道自己什么时候能走出来。

qaPairs.usageNote: 当朋友表达理解你的困境时，回应可体现接受、克制或真实情绪状态，避免过度强装坚强或完全否定对方关心。

qaPairs.triggerText: You don’t have to go through this alone.
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友主动表示支持，你如何回应？

followUps.text: That means a lot—I’d really appreciate it if you could just hang out this weekend.
followUps.text_cn: 这对我意义重大——如果你这周末能陪我待会儿，我会很感激。

followUps.text: I appreciate it, but I need some space right now.
followUps.text_cn: 我很感激，但我现在需要一点独处空间。

followUps.text: Can you help me figure out what to do next?
followUps.text_cn: 你能帮我想想接下来该怎么做吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应支持时，可选择接受帮助、保持距离或请求行动支持，体现真实人际互动中的边界感与需求表达。

qaPairs.triggerText: It’s okay to not be okay.
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友用温和话语接纳你的情绪低落，你如何回应？

followUps.text: I’ve been pretending I’m fine, but you’re right—I’m not.
followUps.text_cn: 我一直假装没事，但你说得对，我确实不是。

followUps.text: I wish I could believe that, but I feel guilty for feeling this way.
followUps.text_cn: 我真希望我能相信这点，但我为有这样的感受而感到内疚。

followUps.text: Yeah… I think I just needed someone to say that out loud.
followUps.text_cn: 是啊……我只是需要有人把这句话说出来。

qaPairs.usageNote: 面对‘不好好也没关系’这类接纳性话语，回应可呈现从否认到接纳的多种心理状态，真实反映情绪恢复的非线性过程。

subScenes.name: 转移焦点
subScenes.description: 引导话题转向积极方向，提供希望与支持。

qaPairs.triggerText: Hey, I know you're upset about the presentation, but have you thought about going for a walk to clear your head?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我知道你对演讲很沮丧，但你有没有想过出去散散步，让脑子清醒一下？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友试图通过建议活动转移注意力来安慰情绪低落的你

followUps.text: That actually sounds good—I’ll grab my headphones and go around the park.
followUps.text_cn: 这主意不错，我去戴上耳机绕公园走一圈。

followUps.text: I don’t think a walk will help right now—I just need to sit with this for a bit.
followUps.text_cn: 我觉得现在散步没用，我需要先自己静一静。

followUps.text: Maybe later—I’ll do it after I text Sarah and vent a little first.
followUps.text_cn: 也许待会儿吧，我先给莎拉发个消息倾诉一下。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友安慰时提出转移注意力的建议，回应需体现真实情绪状态，避免过度积极或敷衍

qaPairs.triggerText: I know you’re stressed about the project, but remember how you aced that group trip last month? You’ve got this.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我知道你对这个项目很焦虑，但你还记得上个月你把团队旅行搞得超棒吗？你肯定行的。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友用过往成功经历鼓励你，试图转移对当前压力的专注

followUps.text: Thanks—I actually forgot how well that went. Maybe I just need to remind myself I can handle pressure.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢，我真忘了那次多顺利。也许我该提醒自己，我其实能应对压力。

followUps.text: That was different—it was fun, this is just overwhelming.
followUps.text_cn: 那不一样，那次是玩，这次真的压得我喘不过气。

followUps.text: I appreciate that. Can we talk about something else for 10 minutes first? I just need a break from work talk.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你。我们能先聊点别的吗？就10分钟，我真想暂时远离工作话题。

qaPairs.usageNote: 当朋友用正面回忆转移焦点时，回应应体现真实情绪层次，而非简单接受或否定

qaPairs.triggerText: You’ve been staring at your laptop all day. Let’s grab a coffee and talk about anything but work.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你盯着电脑一整天了，我们去喝杯咖啡，聊点和工作无关的吧。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友直接提议中断工作状态，通过社交互动转移情绪焦点

followUps.text: Yes, please—I’ve been avoiding my emails and I need a real break.
followUps.text_cn: 好啊，求之不得——我一直在躲邮件，真的需要喘口气。

followUps.text: I can’t right now—I’ve got a deadline in an hour.
followUps.text_cn: 现在不行，我一小时后就要交稿了。

followUps.text: I’d love to—but can we just sit quietly for a bit? I don’t feel like talking much.
followUps.text_cn: 我很想，但我们能只是安静坐一会儿吗？我现在不太想说话。

qaPairs.usageNote: 朋友提出‘暂停工作+社交陪伴’时，回应需区分‘不想做’和‘不能做’，体现情感需求的多样性

subScenes.name: 给予鼓励
subScenes.description: 肯定朋友价值，激励其重新振作面对未来。

qaPairs.triggerText: You've been quiet lately — everything okay?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你最近挺安静的，还好吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友注意到你情绪低落，主动关心并给予鼓励

followUps.text: Thanks for asking. I’ve been stressing about my presentation, but I’m working on it — your support means a lot.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你问。我最近在为演讲紧张，但我正在准备，你的支持对我很重要。

followUps.text: I’m just feeling a bit down right now… I don’t know if I can pull through.
followUps.text_cn: 我现在感觉有点低落……我不知道自己能不能挺过去。

followUps.text: I appreciate you checking in. I just needed someone to notice — I think I’m starting to feel better already.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你关心我。我只是需要有人注意到我——我觉得自己已经开始好起来了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友间情绪低落时的自然回应，体现真实情感层次：从消极到积极的过渡

qaPairs.triggerText: I know this feels overwhelming, but you’ve handled tough stuff before — you’ve got this.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我知道这感觉很难，但你以前也处理过更难的事——你一定行的。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友用过往成功经验鼓励你重拾信心

followUps.text: You’re right — I did get through that project last year. Maybe I just need to take it one step at a time.
followUps.text_cn: 你说得对——我去年确实挺过了那个项目。也许我只需要一步一步来。

followUps.text: I wish I felt as confident as you sound… I’m just scared I’ll mess up again.
followUps.text_cn: 我真希望我能像你听起来那么有信心……我只是害怕会再搞砸。

followUps.text: That actually helps. Can you remind me of that when I start doubting myself again?
followUps.text_cn: 这真的有帮助。等我再怀疑自己的时候，你能提醒我这句话吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 鼓励中提及过往成就，回应需体现真实心理变化，而非简单接受

qaPairs.triggerText: I’m here for you — whether you want to talk or just sit quietly.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我在这儿陪着你——不管你想要聊天，还是只是安静坐着。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友提供无条件陪伴，不强求倾诉

followUps.text: That means so much. I think I just need some quiet time with you nearby.
followUps.text_cn: 这真的让我很感动。我想我现在只需要你在我身边，安静地待一会儿。

followUps.text: I’m not ready to talk yet, but I’m really glad you’re around.
followUps.text_cn: 我还没准备好谈，但真的很高兴你在我身边。

followUps.text: Actually… I think I want to talk now. Can we grab coffee tomorrow?
followUps.text_cn: 其实……我现在想聊聊了。明天我们去喝杯咖啡好吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 体现安慰的核心：不施压、尊重节奏，回应需反映情绪状态的流动性
